newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk Tofas halts production till Jan 13.
newsitem.headline: Turk Tofas halts production till Jan 13.

text.p: Turkey's leading car producer Tofas Turk Otomobil Fabrikalari said it would stop production from Friday until January 13, 1997 due to weak car demand in the domestic market.
In a statement sent to the Istanbul Stock Exchange, Tofas said 76 percent of the wages would be paid to employees during the two-week compulsory leave.
The company said January was usually the month when car sales dipped due to weak seasonal demand and sales were already running far below the normal levels.

Tofas which halted production several times this year, will lay off 1,011 workers, or 22 percent of its workforce from January 2 due to car sales which recently fell sharply due to expectations of cheaper car imports.
It reduced production to a single shift from two on November 26.
